pnpm.//overrides: wrangler 4.152.0 pins miniflare 5.20261019.2-beta, which pins undici 7.29.1 (GHSA-xjj6-f33q-929c, GHSA-4qv8-2p9j-2685, GHSA-f72v-6w45-q472). This forces miniflare's copy (the local dev/test runtime) to the patched 7.x inside the same major. It cannot reach the undici 7.29.1 that wrangler bundles into its own CLI for Cloudflare API calls. Drop once a wrangler release bundles undici >=7.30.1 and ships a miniflare that depends on it.
